admission.justification: State/action projection alone can preserve an unusable or wrongly addressed suggestion; exact leaf binding alone does not preserve argument boundaries; correct argv alone does not preserve the actual operation outcome. Together these three obligations make the following call actionable without granting transaction or acceptance authority.

guarantee: An admitted task or landing answer carries the actual state and blockers with the usable following call; recovery names the exact leaf rather than its master and carries separate real argument values whose printable command quotes the same argv. A bounded answer cannot substitute a guessed address or a merely illustrative shell string for that call.
title: Bounded state and executable addressed recovery
